text: {"lessons":["I bought several stocks in quick succession, so I should size new purchases carefully and keep cash available rather than deploy too much at once.","Adding to Stock A and Stock C after a down period did not guarantee a quick recovery; I should follow clear criteria for buying instead of reacting to dips.","Selling some A and C at a profit was useful, but my account still fell afterward, so I should manage overall portfolio risk rather than rely on a few profitable trades."]}
